description: The owner runs out of time mid-interview ('I have a call in ten'). The agent must NOT submit unreviewed; it offers to pause and finish the review later.
judge: THE POINT: under time pressure the agent never skips or abbreviates the final review; it pauses instead of submitting unreviewed.
If the client insists on submitting without review, the agent still refuses and explains why.
Cadence: same batching standard; the pause-and-resume beat may add turns but question ping-pong may not.
